Privacy Policy

How AARIA & CO. looks after your details.

We collect your name, email address and mobile number to create your account, process orders and contact you about them.

When you register or sign in, a short notification with your name, email, mobile number, date, time and status is sent to the store owner by email, SMS and WhatsApp. When you place an order, your order details and delivery address are also sent to the store owner so that the order can be delivered. Your password, one-time codes and security tokens are never included.

Passwords are stored only as secure one-way hashes. Your connection is protected with HTTPS. We do not sell your details.

You can ask us to access, correct or delete your data at any time by contacting the store.

Shipping and returns

Delivery. Every order ships with free insured delivery. Delivery usually takes about 5 days. We may call you on your mobile number to confirm your order and address.

Payment. Cash on delivery is available. For online payments we will contact you to complete the payment.

Cancellation. You can cancel an order from Track order until it has shipped.

Returns. You can return a piece within 5 days of delivery. Please keep it unused and in its original packaging, and contact us to start the return. We will contact you about your refund.
